title: Register tenant command
description: Registers a tenant for an AUTHORISED TenantOnboardingRequest (ADR-BCP-017 sections 22-24). Approval activates nothing, and there is no direct registration: display_name, isolation_strategy and residency_region must equal the request's desired state, requested_products must equal its product_requirements, and a request produces at most one tenant, which it records as FULFILLED. Tenants that predate the admission workflow are registered through tenant-bootstrap-registration.schema.json instead.
